title: Air Force interrogations, demotions and denial after the Ellsworth incident

tellings.quote: It was what happened afterwards. Their interrogators spent most of their time trying to explain away the experience.

plain: After two Air Force men, Mario Woods and Michael Johnson, reported being taken by aliens at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota in 1977, Air Force interrogators are said to have spent most of their time trying to explain the experience away. Michels tells this himself in an episode where the two veterans meet again fifty years later, saying the worst part for them "was what happened afterwards," which the story describes as interrogations, demotions and denial. He raises it because it would mean the Air Force worked to bury what its own men said happened.
